Name: Cropkeeper - Automated Crop Chests
Author: aLumiGrove
Description:
A tiny bit less farm work for you~
Cropkeeper turns an ordinary vanilla chest into a handy little crop helper. Place one beside connected tilled soil, switch it on, give it some seeds and optional fertilizer, and it’ll take care of harvesting and replanting for you.


[size=4]What it does[/size]

[list]
[*]Harvests ripe crops and tucks them into the chest.[/*]
[*]Replants harvested spots and fills empty tilled soil.[/*]
[*]Uses fertilizer when you’ve stocked some.[/*]
[/list]Nice and simple. You fill the chest, Cropkeeper looks after the field.


[size=4]How to use[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Place a vanilla chest next to tilled soil.[/*]
[*]Open it and switch Cropkeeper on.[/*]
[*]Add your seeds and any fertilizer you want it to use.[/*]
[*]Leave a little room for the harvest![/*]
[/list]Cropkeeper checks your field at 06:00 each morning and will have another look whenever you open and close the chest.
If multiple Cropkeeper chests can reach the same field, the most recently enabled one gets the job.

[size=4]Configuration[/size]

Want a few extra check-ins during the day? Generic Mod Config Menu lets you enable automatic checks every 1 to 4 in-game hours.


[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

Cropkeeper gets along nicely with Automate while keeping its own field logic separate.


[size=4]A few things to know[/size]

[list]
[*]Regrowing crops stay happily planted.[/*]
[*]If the chest is full, ripe crops stay put until there’s room for them.[/*]
[*]Missing the right seed? That spot will simply wait until you add more.[/*]
[*]Automated harvesting doesn’t grant Farming XP or trigger tool or weapon enchantments.[/*]
[*]Seasonal Wild Seeds still need to be planted by hand.[/*]
[*]Garden Pots, fruit trees, tea bushes, forage objects, and ginger aren’t currently supported.[/*]
[/list]That’s about it. Give Cropkeeper a chest full of supplies and let the little thing get to work <3

AI Disclosure: Cropkeeper was developed with AI assistance for coding, review, testing, and documentation.

Downloads.Description: Adds late-season planting protection and optional morning warnings, improves hover information and controller support, and fixes UI scaling and chest-close processing.
